title: Go
tagline: The whole board. The whole family.
taglineZh: 一整张棋盘，一家人慢慢下。

lines.en: Three hundred and sixty-one crossings. Black moves first.
lines.zh: 三百六十一个交叉点，黑棋先行。

lines.en: Go. The whole board, the whole family.
lines.zh: 围棋。一整张棋盘，一家人慢慢下。

lines.en: Place stones, surround ground, and capture groups with no liberties.
lines.zh: 落子、围地，提掉没有气的棋。

lines.en: Four computer levels, from gentle Companion to a playout-driven Hard.
lines.zh: 四档电脑难度，从温和陪玩到会做推演的挑战。

lines.en: Two players on one screen, or a phone joins on the same network.
lines.zh: 两人同屏，或者手机连同一局域网加入。

lines.en: Undo, a hint with a reason, autosave and a family record.
lines.zh: 悔棋、带理由的提示、自动保存和家庭战绩。

lines.en: Go. Count the stones and the ground.
